capabilities: Render notes as a pannable, zoomable org chart driven by a parent link property
Reassign managers by dragging cards and edit or remove reporting lines with undo
Edit card fields inline and group views by a Bases property
Search and highlight people, collapsing and expanding teams
Track current and former members of groups via properties
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 on desktop; phones and tablets are not supported yet. A compatibility section warns that a few features rely on non-public Obsidian API and describes how they degrade if it changes. Further settings documentation lives in docs/settings.md.
intentEvidence: adds an Org Chart view type to Bases, rendering notes as a parent → child hierarchy
problem: Obsidian's Bases has no layout for showing notes as a parent-child hierarchy, so structures like reporting lines or project breakdowns must be read as flat tables.
summary: Bases view type that renders notes as an interactive org chart, linking each note to its parent through a configurable frontmatter property.
